response.justification: Bogdan brings well over the required 8 years of software development experience and genuine developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), taught Selenium/TDD courses, and set up CI/CD, GitLab, Docker and deploy infrastructure. However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: there are no direct reports, no hiring/performance-review responsibilities, and no manager or lead titles across 15+ years, which leaves the explicit 2-year people-management minimum and 3-year technical-leadership requirement unmet on paper. Mobile-platform exposure exists (iOS/tvOS, device orchestration tooling) but is dated and secondary. He is a credible senior IC and community educator; the gap is the leadership half of the role, so a screening call could clarify informal lead/mentoring scope before advancing.
strengths: Deep developer-tooling background: test runner, assertion library, CI/CD and build infrastructure
15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop and embedded
Strong teaching/mentoring signal via workshops, courses, dojos and open-source leadership
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports
No formal tech-lead or engineering-manager titles despite long tenure
Mobile-platform experience is limited and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
